messages:
Noah: Quick shout — big news alert 🚨 Keisha just accepted a promotion to Director of Product AND she and Sam are getting married next month! Thought we should celebrate. ❤️🎉
Keisha: omg 😭 thank you thank you. so grateful for this team. wedding is 2026-05-14 (small), would love to see any of you there. also happy to celebrate at the office beforehand!
Arjun: congrats @Keisha!!! massively deserved. can we sign a card?
Noah: created a card signup doc: https://docs.google.com/fake-link (pls add messages/gift ideas)
Maya: :tada: I'll bring cupcakes on Friday for a mini-celebration. what time works? noon-ish?
Priya: Congrats!!! happy to contribute to a group gift. Venmo/PayPal?
Derek: Huge congrats Keisha!! quick Q — will you be OOO around the wedding? want to make sure coverage for your PMs
Keisha: Thanks everyone ❤️ I'm taking 3 days (Thu-Fri + travel). already flagged in my calendar. coverage: Arjun and Maya are briefed on the top priorities.
Priya: cool. count me in for the gift — venmo @priya-pay (I'll collect and send to Noah to buy the gift)
Arjun: putting a reminder on my calendar for the office celebration. Noah, can you book the back commons?
Noah: booked the commons for Fri 11:45–12:30. cake/cupcakes welcome. I've added the signup doc link in the #random pinned messages.
Maya: adding gluten-free options to my list. any allergy notes from Keisha?
Keisha: no major allergies, GF would be awesome — thank youuuu
hr-bot: Reminder: if taking wedding time off, please submit a PTO request in Workday.
Derek: will do. also can someone snag a group photo during the office thing?
Priya: i'll be there with phone camera ready :camera_with_flash:
Noah: beautiful. thanks all — congrats again @Keisha!! let's make it fun but low-key.
Keisha: you all are the best. heart explode 💥
